title: Inspect a distribution
note: Twenty synthetic observations. Replace the values in cell 1 and choose a bin count. The final histogram bin includes its right edge. A histogram alone does not establish normality.

Mean: %.2f

Range: %.2f to %.2f
Bins: %d
", s.Count, s.Mean, s.Median, s.Min, s.Max, bins)
